da-circular.notes: Pure algebraic identity on a fixed polynomial; no calibration or target-fitting involved.

da-overclaim.notes: Two overclaims. (1) The proposition states tr_M(B_p)(1/q) = -tr_M(B_p)(q) 'Equivalently' to the polynomial identity, but the Lean (and the witness) only establish the polynomial fact q^20 p(1/q) = -p(q); the trace-level statement also requires the denominator 12q^10 to transform correctly, which is asserted in prose, not proved. (2) The 'Generalization conjecture' (lines 82-97) gives a general (-1)^{ℓ(B_K)} formula with shift(K)=18Z+21N+1, presented with a worked sign rationale ('word length 11 odd parity') — a single example (proton) generalized to all closed braids; this is conjectural extrapolation framed with more confidence than one verified case supports. The block is kind=proposition but lines 80-97 are conjecture.

da-hidden-dof.notes: The conjecture introduces shift(K) = 18Z + 21N + 1 'per the integer-LP closure' with no derivation in-block of where 18, 21, 1 come from; these look like fitted/assigned crossing-count weights. For the proposition proper (the proton p(q)) there is no hidden DOF, but the conjecture section smuggles three unexplained integer coefficients.

da-non-sequitur.notes: The 'minus sign reflects odd parity of word length ℓ(B_p)=11' explanation is asserted, not derived: the Categorical interpretation invokes tr(S^2(x))=tr(x) for Frobenius algebras (which gives a +, not a -), then attributes the actual minus to '11-crossing (odd) length contributes a parity sign' without a lemma connecting word-length parity to the sign of q^d p(1/q). The sign is verified for this p(q) by direct computation, but the rep-theoretic 'why' is a plausibility narrative with a missing lemma.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: The .md Proposition's headline claim is the TRACE identity tr_M(B_p)(1/q) = -tr_M(B_p)(q) (and the boxed q^20 p(1/q) = -p(q)). The Lean proves only the polynomial-numerator identity shiftedReverse20 protonClosedFormPolynomial = -protonClosedFormPolynomial — a weaker, denominator-free combinatorial fact. The Lean docstring is honest that it 'proves the algebraic-combinatorial identity that supports' the categorical claim, but per proof-statement-integrity the Lean is strictly weaker than the .md proposition statement (no tr_M object, no 12q^10 denominator, no Hopf-antipode descent). validation: not_checked.

da-citation-misuse.notes: cites [wenzl1988], [hoefsmit1974] (seminormal reduction that produced the closed form), [kassel1995] Ch III (Hopf antipode + Frobenius integrals) are correctly attributed to the invoked machinery.

da-definitional-ambiguity.notes: B_p ('the proton braid in B_3 used in prop:atomic-mass-gb-nf') and the closed form tr_M(B_p)=p(q)/(12q^10) are stated as if canonical, but the sibling axiomatic block gives a DIFFERENT tr_M(σ₁⁷σ₂⁴) = (num)/(q^10(q+1)^3) ≈ 1.63315 whereas this one = p(q)/(12q^10) ≈ 0.4331. The two 'proton Markov traces' are distinct objects (Plancherel w_λ vs Jones–Markov y_λ) sharing the symbol tr_M; this block does not flag the distinction, so a reader cannot tell which tr_M is meant from this block alone.

da-empirical-fragility.notes: The identity is symbolic/exact (sympy + sorry-free Lean), not a numerical near-match; no q0-anchored value or cross-anchor swing involved.

da-physical-implausibility.notes: No physical-observable claim; an algebraic symmetry of a trace polynomial.

da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: minor-revision. referee_argument: the core polynomial identity q^20 p(1/q) = -p(q) is true and proved sorry-free in Lean — the proposition's hard content is solid. Strongest objection (compound): (a) the Lean proves only the denominator-free numerator identity, strictly weaker than the .md's trace-level claim tr_M(B_p)(1/q)=-tr_M(B_p)(q) (lean-narrative-divergence); (b) the cited witness/script are deprecated/missing at the recorded paths (reproducibility); (c) the 'Generalization conjecture' with shift=18Z+21N+1 is conjectural extrapolation embedded in a kind=proposition block with three unexplained integers. Fix: re-point the witness to its current path, demote the generalization to a clearly-marked conjecture block, and either prove the trace-level identity (denominator transform) or restate the Lean claim as the numerator identity it actually is.
